responses.message: CloudSTTAdapter and STTFallbackChain break SpeechToTextPort contract
responses.action_taken: Fixed. Changed CloudSTTAdapter.transcribe() signature from (audio, language: String = "") to (audio, language: String) to match port contract. responses.message: Polish normalization uses global substring replacement corrupting common words
responses.action_taken: Already fixed. Replaced simple String.replace() with regex-based _regex_replace() helper that uses word boundary matching. Lines 32-35 now use \b (word boundary) anchors for "dzis" -> "dzisiaj". Lines 38-39 use specific context-aware replacements.

responses.message: STTFallbackChain depends on concrete adapter types instead of SpeechToTextPort interface
responses.action_taken: Fixed as part of finding #2. Changed _cloud_adapter type from CloudSTTAdapter to SpeechToTextPort. All method calls now use has_method() checks and call() to maintain port abstraction.

responses.message: Intent extraction only matches infinitive verb forms
responses.action_taken: Already fixed. Lines 56-80 now include both infinitive and imperative forms: budować/buduj/zbuduj, usunąć/usuń, przesunąć/przesuń, przenieść/przenieś, grać/graj, zagrać/zagraj.
